# bookmarker

https://bookmarker.lol

## What is bookmarker?

bookmarker is a native iOS app that consolidates all your saved content from Instagram, X (Twitter), TikTok, and YouTube into one searchable library. It solves the problem of scattered, unsearchable bookmarks across multiple social media apps.

## Key features

- **Universal save**: Save any link from any social app into one unified library
- **Auto-categorization**: Every save is automatically categorized by topic (Technology, Food & Drink, Fitness, etc.)
- **Full-text search**: Find anything you've saved by searching the actual content, not just titles
- **Share extension**: Save directly from Instagram, X, TikTok, YouTube, Safari, and any app with a share sheet
- **SwiftUI + SwiftData**: Native iOS app built with modern Apple frameworks, no backend required
- **Privacy-first**: Your data stays on your device with optional iCloud sync

## How it works

1. Install the bookmarker iOS app from the App Store
2. Use the share sheet in any app (Instagram, X, TikTok, YouTube, Safari) to save a link
3. bookmarker automatically fetches the content, categorizes it, and adds it to your library
4. Search and browse your saves by topic, platform, or full-text search

## Who is it for?

- People who save hundreds or thousands of posts across multiple social apps
- Content creators who need to organize inspiration and references
- Researchers collecting sources from various platforms
- Anyone who's ever thought "I saved that somewhere but can't find it"

## Pricing

- Free tier available
- Premium features for advanced users

## Platform availability

- iOS app (native SwiftUI)
- Web app at bookmarker.lol for browsing and managing your library

## Common use cases

- Organizing recipe videos saved from Instagram and TikTok
- Collecting workout routines from YouTube and Instagram
- Saving articles and threads from X for later reading
- Building topic-based collections (travel inspiration, coding tutorials, etc.)
- Sharing curated collections with others via public links

## Technical details

- Built with SwiftUI and SwiftData
- Share Extension for system-wide integration
- Automatic content enrichment and categorization
- Cross-device sync via iCloud
- Supports URL normalization to prevent duplicates
